files.name: query.sql

prompt.vi: Tạo bảng reviews gồm: id (khoá chính), product_id (NOT NULL), rating (chỉ nhận 1 đến 5, dùng CHECK) và comment. Cột phải có đúng các tên đó.
prompt.en: Create a table reviews with: id (primary key), product_id (NOT NULL), rating (only 1 to 5, use CHECK) and comment. The columns must have exactly those names.

hint.vi: CREATE TABLE reviews (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), comment TEXT);
hint.en: CREATE TABLE reviews (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), comment TEXT);

solution.name: query.sql

label.en: The reviews table has all 4 columns

label.vi: Thêm đánh giá hợp lệ (rating 5) thành công
label.en: A valid review (rating 5) can be inserted

checks.test: (function(){try{q("INSERT INTO reviews (product_id, rating, comment) VALUES (1, 5, 'ok')");return q('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews')[0][0]===1}catch(e){return false}})()

label.vi: Rating 9 bị từ chối bởi CHECK

checks.test: (function(){try{q('INSERT INTO reviews (product_id, rating) VALUES (1, 9)');return false}catch(e){return true}})()

prompt.vi: Tạo chỉ mục tên idx_orders_customer trên orders(customer_id), và một VIEW tên completed_orders chứa các đơn có status = 'completed'.
prompt.en: Create an index named idx_orders_customer on orders(customer_id), and a VIEW named completed_orders holding the orders with status = 'completed'.

hint.vi: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id); CREATE VIEW completed_orders AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';
hint.en: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders(customer_id); CREATE VIEW completed_orders AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

solution.name: query.sql

checks.test: q("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_orders_customer'").length===1
